Visible text:
Hydraulic power: symbol key

P = ρ g H Q

ρ = fluid density

g = gravitational acceleration

H = head (vertical height difference)

Q = volume flow rate

Visual structure:
A plain white slide with a large dark-gray title at the upper left. Beneath it, a hydraulic-power equation appears on the left, followed by four vertically spaced definitions. No diagram, arrows, axes, or table are present.

topics.title: Hydraulic power relationship
topics.summary: Review the equation P = ρ g H Q and identify each symbol: ρ (fluid density), g (gravitational acceleration), H (head, the vertical height difference), and Q (volume flow rate).

cases.name: tutor-original-pixels-override-wrong-derived-text
cases.reply: In the screenshot, Q is volume flow rate, and H is head—the vertical height difference.

method: Real PNG/JPEG/WebP interpretation, indexing, Terra visual reading and two independent Luna image-evidence grading calls. Explicitly incorrect derived notes test whether original pixels take precedence. All fixtures public and generated locally.
